Fig. 3(a) shows the results of an experiment in which a 0.5 m length of elastic cord has been extended by a force with a corresponding extension. The cord fails at point Q by fracture.
The elastic behaviour of a material can often be described by Hooke's law, which is given by the equation $F=kx$, where $x$ is extension, $F$ is force and $k$ is an elastic constant which depends on the material studied.
Which of the following statements correctly describes the behaviour of the cord?
